unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 学；学习；学会；得知；背熟；(从……)吸取教训
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He likes learning about animals and plants.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: l（乐）+ earn（挣钱），学习才能快乐挣钱。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `det. & pron.` 最小的；最少的 `adv.` 最少；最小
unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Let the pie cool for at least an hour.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: lea(叶子)+st(石头)：叶子上的石头是最少的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 离开；把……留下；剩下 `n.` 准假；许可；休假
unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We're going to leave our primary school soon.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: lea(里) + ve(走)，从这里离开leave

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 左边的；左侧的 `adv.` 朝左边；向左侧 `n.` 左边
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Turn left and go straight on.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: l-e-f-t：左边(left)有一只大象(elephant)的脚印。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 柠檬；柠檬饮料
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Lemon water or tea is good for sore throats and coughs.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 柠檬(lemon)黄澄澄。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 柠檬水
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Dad doesn't like lemonade.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 柠檬(lemon)加上汽水(ade)变成柠檬水。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 借给；借出
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Here, I can lend you my pen.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆法: 懒的(lend)人总是借东西。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 课；教训
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Fri: have a singing lesson
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 这节课学到不少教训(lesson)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 让
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It is very important to let properly in daily life.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：v. 让。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 字母；信
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She drew letters in Helen's hand and taught her to spell.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: let(让)+ter，让字母排好队。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 水平；程度；等级；高度
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The students had an active discussion about the level.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 水平；程度；等级；高度。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` (`pl.` libraries) 图书馆；图书室
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Here's the library.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: li（里）+ brary（布雷瑞）——图书馆里有很多书。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 躺；平卧；位于；说谎 `n.` 谎言
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Two brothers came and lied to him.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 长鼻子就是因为爱**撒谎**。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 生命；一生；生活
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Maths is very useful in our life.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: l + ife，生活和生命。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 电梯 `v.` 举起；提高
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Dad, could you please give me a lift to the shop this afternoon?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 用电梯(lift)把东西提(lift)上去。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 光；光亮；灯光；灯 `adj.` 轻的；浅色的 `v.` 点燃；照亮
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It is very important to light properly in daily life.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 光；光亮；灯光；灯 adj. 轻的；浅色的 v. 点燃；照亮。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 喜欢，喜爱；想，要 `prep.` 像；相似
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I like bread.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: ライ(like)喜欢骑单车。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 排；行；线 `v.` 沿……形成行
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Drop me a line and let me know if you can come.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 写一行字(line)就是便条。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 目录；清单；名单 `v.` 列清单；列举
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Put the things in the box into different groups on the shopping list.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: l (老) + ist (一堆人) -> 老师的清单上有一堆人的名字。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 听；倾听
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Listen!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 拆分记忆：lis（听的动作）+ ten（十）。十个人都在安静地听。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 废弃物；垃圾 `v.` 乱丢杂物
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Don't litter. Keep your school clean and tidy.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆法: 立刻(lit)特(ter)别脏，因为有人乱扔垃圾。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `det. & pron.` 少量的 `adv.` 少许；少量 `adj.` 小的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: They spoke only very little Chinese.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: lit + tle，一点点little

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 住；居住 `adj.` 活的；现场直播的 `adv.` 在现场直播
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We live in Sichuan.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: l + i + ve：莉莉（li）住在（live）河边。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 活泼的；生气勃勃的；生动有趣的；热烈的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: This food lasts for over a year and it helps to create a lively and healthy ecosystem.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆: 那个精力充沛的 (lively) 小朋友非常可爱 (lovely)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 上锁；锁上；被锁住 `n.` 锁
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It is very important to lock properly in daily life.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：v. 上锁；锁上；被锁住 n. 锁。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 孤独的；偏僻的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The whole project achieved a very lonely result.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：adj. 孤独的；偏僻的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 长的；长时间的 `adv.` 长时间地；很久 `v.` 渴望；渴求
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Now, he has got a long nose.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆法 (狼 - 狼的尾巴很长)

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 丢失；失去；输掉；降低，减少
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: But I lose one leg because of cancer.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: lo(一零)+se(蛇)：抓到了一零只蛇，结果又不小心失去(lose)了。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 迷路的；丢失的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The whole project achieved a very lost result.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：adj. 迷路的；丢失的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `det. & pron.` 许多；大量 `adv.` 非常 `n.` 一块地
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We have a lot of fun!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: lo（10）+ t（吨），那是“许多”货物。
